rationale: The dev's diff already authored dashboard-zoom-brush.spec.js (6 tests) plus the dashboard-zoom-drag.js page object and registered the spec in ci_matrix.json 'Dashboards-Charts' shard — no new spec is needed. Five of the six tests exercise WIRED behavior and are correct as written. The single defect is TC-ZOOM-001: it asserts the brush flips the dashboard to an absolute time range, but that chain is UNWIRED (ChartRenderer.vue:472 emits 'updated:dataZoom' camelCase while PanelSchemaRenderer.vue:98 listens '@updated:data-zoom' kebab-case; Vue 3 does no case normalization). As a real test it will fail against current main. The only change required is converting TC-ZOOM-001 to a parked test.fixme placeholder, which is an in-place edit of the existing test — hence 'extend'. needs_registration=false because the spec file is already present in ci_matrix.json.
